unit.why: A short narrative: R. Moshe (of Ujhely), seeing the crowds arriving for the High Holidays, takes suffering upon himself in the mikveh on the eve of Yom Kippur, and this explains his illnesses.

stories.start_quote: רבינו משה הי׳ בעל יסורין בכמה מיני
stories.summary_en: On the eve of Yom Kippur, seeing the market full of hundreds of visitors, R. Moshe, in humility, declares in the mikveh that he accepts suffering on behalf of all Israel, which is how his many illnesses came about.
